tweet.text:
We've all been hearing about Telegram games, and the growth that $TON is having 📈

One of the top games on Telegram, PixelTap, was recently developed by @pixelverse_xyz 

PixelVerse has one of the top Telegram games AND just announced their own L2, PixelChain 🔗

Let's take a look at everything they're working on ⬇️

General info:

Pixelverse is a game ecosystem and web3 brand created by Kori @koritual who is a former Binance listing and Trust Wallet team member

Pixelverse is among the top 10 Telegram channels worldwide and their Twitter account has almost 3 million followers

Their token is launching on July 18th with a spot listing on Bybit at 12 PM UTC, making it the second mover after the success of Notcoin

PixelChain:

PixelVerse recently announced PixelChain which is the first fully EVM-compatible Layer 2 for TON

With more than 75 million registered users and 15m daily active users, onboarding these users to PixelChain  would make Pixelchain the most active and utilized gamefi focused blockchain in the world

The info on their tokenomics will be released soon!

Partnerships & Investors:

➡️ Pixelverse has support from the TON Foundation and has raised $8 million+ from investors including Galaxy, Delphi Digital, and Merit Circle

➡️ Integration with leading meme coin $MEW on Solana, and $COQ on Avalanche

➡️ Pixelverse entered a partnership with the leading NFT collection and Web3 brand @pudgypenguins 

My overall thoughts are that Pixelverse has serious potential, and TON is going to grow throughout this bullrun!

I want to thank the PixelVerse team for partnering with me to showcase their ecosystem and everything they're working on!
